Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}

The Gargoyles are not a clan sired in the traditional sense but a servitor bloodline bred by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere}, who transformed captive @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce}, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel}, and @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.UhaIbwzsC1O2x9vr]{Nosferatu} stock into monstrous, stone-skinned guardian-warriors to protect the young Warlock clan from its enemies. For nearly a thousand years the Gargoyles served their @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} masters in unbreakable thrall, but in recent nights a number have broken free of that control. The bloodline is now split between Slaves, who remain bound to Tremere service, and Freemen, who have won their liberty but still choose, out of habit or spite, to remain within the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}. Whether created through the old transformation rite or, increasingly, Embraced outright, a Gargoyle loses nearly all memory of her former life upon joining the bloodline, leaving most to either obsess over their lost identity or embrace their fresh start.

Disciplines: Fortitude, Potence, Visceratika

Advantage: Every Gargoyle is born with the first level of the innate, non-Discipline ability of Flight, and their nature as tireless sentries and spies grants them a free level of Awareness.

Disadvantage: Gargoyles are hideous, alien monsters even by Kindred standards; they cannot possess Appearance-related Social Traits such as Alluring, Gorgeous, or Seductive without the aid of powers like Obfuscate, and while their true forms are visible they suffer the Negative Traits Repugnant or Bestial, which cannot be bought off with Experience or Free Traits. A Gargoyle in true form cannot initiate Social Challenges except to intimidate, though it may still defend against them. Because the Tremere built a weakness into their creations, every Gargoyle also carries the Negative Trait Submissive x2 when resisting Dominate or other mind-controlling effects.

Organization: Gargoyle society is defined by the divide between Slaves, still bound in deep thrall to Tremere chantries, and Freemen, who wander in search of a place to roost but remain loyal to the Camarilla as a whole. Most player characters are Freemen; a Gargoyle's stoic, patient nature makes her slow to act, but once committed she follows through with speed and decisiveness that belies her stony exterior.
